Component flow — how the open store becomes a governed product

Components are published to the Open*Hubs store, selected + proven by the Teleon runtime, and served as managed, verified context by Baltor. AIDevObserver watches the usage.

architectural law: Baltor → Teleon → OpenHarnessHub, never the reverse (consumption flows up; dependency points down)
Open*Hubs — publishes components Teleon — selects + proves (efficiency) Baltor — serves verified context (truth) AIDevObserver — watches usage

Solid teal = consumption flows up (components → proven capability). Dashed grey = dependency points down (Baltor depends on Teleon depends on Open*Hubs, never reverse). serves_truth=false · prototype.
